mu_name_from: MuMain loads pants indexes 10 to 14 from PantElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 150: `AccessModel(MODEL_PANTS + i + 10, ..., L"PantElf", i + 1)`), so index 14 is PantElf05, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Guardian Pants. mu.db agrees: code 4622, group 9 index 14, Player/PantElf05.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's fifth and last 0.75 set, and the one Eo the Craftsman sells after Spirit - all five pieces at +3 on his shelf (src/sim/market.cpp, kCraftsman). Silver plate with gilt edging, the brightest metal in her wardrobe, and the piece that finishes his shelf.
profile_from: armour, not soft_armour. Guardian is polished silver plate with gilt edging on every sheet (upper_03, lower_03, gloves_03b, boots_03b are all grey metal at chroma about 22 with gold scroll along the edges), so plate_steel, the armour default, is what almost all of it is.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 101. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. Eighty agility beside forty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/lower_03.OZJ (128x128), hide.jpg and lower_03b.OZT (64x64), from MuMain. The .bmd names lower_03.jpg, hide.jpg and lower_03b.tga; 106 of the 134 triangles are on the first, 12 on hide and 16 on lower_03b.
sheet_note: lower_03 is silver tassets over the hips and greaves below, gold-scrolled at the knee, front and back. Mean (150, 149, 145) at chroma 22. lower_03b is a tall gilt ornament - a flared gold blade edged in silver - on a 64-square whose alpha cuts 23% away. hide is MU capping the openings.
material_note: Three islands. Island 0 is 118 triangles, lower_03's 106 and hide's 12 - the tassets, greaves and their caps - plate_steel. Islands 1 and 2 are 8 each, lower_03b's 16: the tall gilt blades on their own alpha sheet, standing off the hip (island 1 reaches z 45.9, well above the belt). brass, by the rule the Brass set wrote - a separate ornament on its own .OZT is cast, not beaten.
